About this site

# Bioinformatics Notes {.about-name}

::: {.about-role}
Maintained by Jie Hua · Biomedical Center, LMU Munich
:::

::: {.about-lede}
A working notebook of reproducible bioinformatics — short, practical notes on genomes, structures, and the tools that make analysis easier.
:::

This site collects solutions worth finding twice: plotting recipes, annotation and assembly formats, protein-structure workflows, and command-line patterns. Each note is written to be copy-pasteable and easy to revisit. It is built with Quarto and published on Netlify.
